title: Workflows, agents and who owns the control flow

items.stem: Control flow means the order of steps a system takes. What is the difference between an agent and a workflow, in terms of who owns the control flow?

options.text: In a workflow the model owns it; in an agent the code owns it
An agent uses tools and a workflow never calls a model at all
In a workflow the code owns it; in an agent the model owns it
Both let the model pick each step, but an agent has more steps

items.stem: Your makerspace assistant handles this request type: a student confirms a booking, and every time the code must check the calendar, then reserve the slot, then send a confirmation email, in that order. Which design is the better choice for this part?

options.text: A fixed workflow, because the steps and their order are known in advance
An agent, because the model can then decide each step as it goes along
An agent, because only an agent is allowed to call tools like a calendar
A fixed workflow, because a workflow never needs a language model at all

items.stem: A Python program always does the same three things for each question: it calls the model to classify the question, searches the manuals with that label, then calls the model again to write the answer. Which description fits this system?

options.text: An agent, because the model is called more than once per question
An agent, because it searches the manuals as one of its steps
Neither, because a system with a model call in it is always an agent
A workflow, because the code fixes the order of steps, not the model

items.stem: In one or two words, what decides the next step in an agent's loop, where in a fixed workflow the program's code decides it?
Which part of the makerspace assistant is the strongest candidate to be an agent, rather than a fixed workflow?

options.text: Writing the same booking confirmation email after each booking
Answering open questions that need an unknown number of manual lookups
Checking the calendar for one machine and one date the student named
Logging each finished booking to the team's usage spreadsheet

items.stem: A fixed workflow answers a question with exactly 2 model calls. An agent handling the same question requests 4 tools, one per model call, and then writes its final answer in one more call. How many more model calls does the agent make than the workflow?
